title: First box was great; second not at all
text: The first box I received of "baked goods" had items my cat loved, especially with what must have been fresh catnip. It was well packaged and the box itself was adopted as a favored toy (catnip flavored?). The second box had items that my cat totally ignored: Two more catnip pillow toys and a piece of cloth sewn into an apron???.  She didn't like the edible treats in either box. Not a good value for the money, so I cancelled the subscription
label: neutral
